entities.summary: Johannes "John" Lind, Also known as "Honest John", was an American politician from Minnesota. He served as the 14th governor of Minnesota from 1899 to 1901 and represented the state in the United States Congress for four terms. Lind also played an important role in the Mexican Revolution as an envoy for President Woodrow Wilson.
